svg.title: A zipper that opens onto a starry galaxy, on brown skin, in five pictures. 1: a light outline of a long lens-shaped opening, and a line below it where the zipper is still closed. 2: fill the opening with dark navy and purple, a soft pink glow and tiny white stars. 3: small gray teeth along both edges of the opening, and interlocking teeth down the closed part. 4: a dark shadow inside the top-left edge of the opening, white shines on the teeth, and the silver slider and pull tab with a small cast shadow. Done: a sparkle on the slider and a faint light line along the bottom-right edge.
